column1: # wiki_provenance.tsv -- binds each SHIPPED wiki image digest to the CM044 source
# commit it was built from. verify_cut_freshness.sh reads this to answer "what
# source produced the image this cut actually pins?". Without a row a pinned
# digest is unverifiable and the gate is fail-closed RED.
# 2026-08-06 ORM (v1.0.15): both images built at 01:27 from CM044 36cc552
# ("exclude the current year from 'On this day' + first test on it", branch
# fix/on-this-day-current-year). CONTENT-VERIFIED, not inferred from timestamps:
# returns 5, i.e. the pinned image demonstrably carries that fix.
# KNOWN GAP, flagged to Andy 2026-08-06: 36cc552 is NOT on any remote. Pushing
# (ostler-ai, creativemachines-ai) -- a credentials gap, not a missing repo.
# Until Andy pushes it, this image's source exists only on the cut machine and
# is not independently rebuildable. Not a content risk for this DMG (the image
# is content-verified above and lives in ghcr), but it MUST be resolved before
# anyone else can reproduce the wiki images.
